0022600170.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-3, 0-2 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (3-3, on a three-game winning streak) in a matchup that puts the Suns 11th in the West and the Warriors 10th. In the season series, the Suns lead 1-0 in 2026-27 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, and they lost 1-3 to the Warriors in 2025-26. Phoenix is without Mark Williams (out, shoulder surgery), while Golden State is missing Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest).
